body:
Adds Seedling, Bramble Dance, Velvet Orbit and Tidepool as selectable soundtrack sets in the in-game Options menu, alongside Original and Random each match. The selection persists across sessions. Each set has aligned calm/building/combat tracks for the existing mood crossfades; switching sets restarts the current mood. The mixer validates a complete trio before replacing its decoders and preserves the current soundtrack if loading fails.

Includes the playable Ogg files, editable MIDI scores and composition generators. One FluidSynth renderer uses a pinned GeneralUser GS bank, fixed render settings and saved mix levels. The encoder verifies all three outputs before installing them. Source documentation covers regeneration and matched-level A/B previews; downloaded banks, draft auditions and WAV previews are excluded from Git.

Validation:
- macOS optimized client build and music integration harness: discovery, invalid-set rollback, mood preservation, active audio callbacks, selector actions, mute state and saved preferences.
- Seven Python tests pass with assertions disabled, including complete encoding, invalid input, mid-trio encoding failure, MIDI timing and repeat rendering.
- All 12 MIDI files reproduce byte-for-byte from their generators. Audio verification confirms stereo 44.1 kHz, matching loop lengths within each set and no clipped decoded samples.

Manual visual inspection of the Options menu remains pending; the integration harness constructs it at 640×480 and exercises its selector callbacks. FluidSynth rendering has been verified on macOS; bit-identical synthesis across platforms is not claimed.
